items.headline: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
items.excerpt: The deal highlights the challenges of developing massive AI data centers.

items.headline: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
items.excerpt: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.

items.headline: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
items.excerpt: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.

items.headline: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
items.excerpt: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.

items.headline: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
items.excerpt: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.

items.headline: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
items.excerpt: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

items.headline: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
items.excerpt: Despite its small size, Underdog's new model can generate both speech and music.

items.headline: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
items.excerpt: Physicl is trying to solve the sim-to-real gap with a pipeline originally built to market goods online.

items.headline: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
items.excerpt: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

items.headline: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
items.excerpt: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

items.headline: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
items.excerpt: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

items.headline: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
items.excerpt: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

items.headline: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
items.excerpt: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.

items.headline: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
items.excerpt: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday, the executive touted how the company had been gaining ground in the enterprise market, where rival Anthropic had already successfully made inroads.

items.headline: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
items.excerpt: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.

items.headline: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
items.excerpt: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.

items.headline: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
items.excerpt: The deal is expected to support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.

items.headline: Aina’s smart ring has a screen, a joystick, and a mic so you can talk to AI agents
items.excerpt: Aina's ring can also take calls and help you dictate notes on your Mac.
